EV-0270 — Press set, 1988–1995: BP Pension Fund sold about 1,300 acres of Welsh land to Intercontinental Land & Development (Cardiff) Ltd for £29,375,400 (Oct 1988); the Land Authority for Wales bought plots at Llandough (Nov 1988), later passing Leckwith/Llandough woods to South Glamorgan County Council (1994–95)


Catalogue entry **EV-0270** of the Great House Farm evidence register, carried over from the Legal Wiki evidence page last modified on 2026-10-21. The same record is published at `research.bucklerfamily.estate <https://research.bucklerfamily.estate/evidence/ev-0270-bp-pension-fund-1988-sale-intercontinental-law-llandough-press/>`__, and this version is also a `PDF <https://wayback.bucklerfamily.estate/pdf/docs-archive/ghf_evidence/ev_0270/en/2026-10-23_EV-0270_ghf_evidence-ev_0270_en_v1-0-0.pdf>`__ in the wayback archive.
